LESSON: GRAMMAR 12.3.1 ASPECT : PRESENT AND PAST PERFECT

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade four
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 12
Topic 12.3: Grammar 12.3.1 Aspect : Present and Past Perfect
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Grammar 12.3.1 Aspect : Present and Past Perfect, part of Strand 12 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade four General.

Key inquiry question: How do we show the time an action took place? 2. How do we show that an action has been completed?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. recognize signs of words and phrases related to the theme, clean environment,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Grammar 12.3.1 Aspect : Present and Past Perfect in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. identify the present and past perfect aspect in varied texts for effective communication.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Grammar 12.3.1 Aspect : Present and Past Perfect in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. use the present perfect and past perfect aspect to form correct sentences for effective communication.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Grammar 12.3.1 Aspect : Present and Past Perfect in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

D. appreciate the importance of proper aspect in everyday communication. ● In pairs, learners are guided to watch a captioned video clip or observe a signed demonstration of vocabulary related to Sports. ● In pairs, learners are guided to identify, fingerspell and sign vocabulary related to Sports. ● In groups, learner is guided to read, and sign read sentences in the present and past perfect aspect related to the theme such as: Present perfect aspect: o The county government has implemented new recycling programs to reduce waste. o Our community has planted thousands of trees to improve air quality. o The school has organized several clean- up projects to maintain cleanliness. ● In groups, learner is guided to read and sign read sentences in the present and past perfect tenses related to the theme such as: Past perfect aspect: o The county government had implemented new recycling programs to reduce waste. o Our community had planted thousands of trees to improve air quality. o The school had organized several clean- up projects to maintain cleanliness. 1. How do we show the time an action took place? 2. How do we show that an action has been completed? 111 ● In pairs, learners are guided to respond to questions, as they sign, on activities they have just completed depicting the present and past perfect tenses. ● In pairs, learners are guided to use games to form sentences in the present perfect and past perfect with given verbs. ● In groups, learners are guided to repeat sentences containing present perfect and past perfect tenses from a story or poem. ● In pairs, learners are guided to create a list of sentences in the present perfect and past perfect on a computer or tablet. ● In groups, learners are guided to construct sentences using the present perfect and past perfect tenses. ● In groups, learners are guided to sign sing songs containing the present perfect and past perfect tenses.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Grammar 12.3.1 Aspect : Present and Past Perfect together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication and collaboration: learners develop the skill of teamwork as they engage in games in small groups or in pairs.

● Self-efficacy: as learners confidently use the correct tenses in their communication

Values:
Unity: cooperation as learners in groups sign sing songs containing the present perfect and past perfect tenses respect.

Link to other subjects

Learner is able to link the concept of tenses to their learning in Kiswahili.
